# Copilot Instructions

## Development Workflow

**IMPORTANT: DO NOT ask the user to run the development server or any commands unless explicitly requested.**

The user has a working development environment and will run commands when needed. Focus on:

1. Code analysis and fixes
2. Implementation of requested features
3. Debugging and problem-solving
4. File modifications and improvements

## Key Preferences

- Do not prompt to run `npm run dev`, `npm start`, or similar commands
- Do not ask to open browsers or check localhost
- Focus on code solutions and file modifications
- Provide implementation without asking for permission to proceed
- User will test and run applications independently

## Project Context

This is a Next.js job tracker application with:

- TypeScript
- Redux Toolkit for state management
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Backend API integration
- Document upload/management system

## Code Standards

- Use existing patterns established in the codebase
- Follow TypeScript best practices
- Maintain consistency with existing components
- Handle errors gracefully with fallbacks
- Optimize for performance and user experience
